go_no_go_basis.why_not_GO: All eight DOFs are semantically and anatomically matched, and units/sign/zero-semantics/order are closed; DB9's own ruler is fully recovered from the bytes. But no CROSS-SOURCE calibration record exists on either side, and the only available cross-source statistic (per-dimension median gap, 10.57-31.23 deg) is confounded by task composition: the audit measured the emg2pose-side session spread at 3.74x the cross-dataset median gap and stated that no per-dimension cross-dataset claim in the 20-30 deg range is resolvable with this corpus at all. One minimal, pre-declared, outcome-free check can bound it.
go_no_go_basis.why_not_NO_GO: No required DOF lacks a defensible physical correspondence. All eight have ESTABLISHED anatomical correspondence, unit compatibility, sign compatibility and zero SEMANTICS. No arbitrary fitted alignment is required to state the mapping; the open question is measurement equivalence, not identity.

closed_facts: Anatomical correspondence for all 8 frozen DOFs (criteria A and B PASS x16).
Source indexing: DB9 order_of_angles indices 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 9, 13, 15 and the emg2pose constants.py indices 2, 3, 5, 6, 9, 13, 17, 18.
Units: DB9 degrees, emg2pose radians, explicit pi/180, reproduced bit-exactly across 77 files / 77,354,864 samples (max |diff| 8.88e-16 rad).
Sign: positive = flexion on both sides for all 8 (DB9 Table 6 documented; emg2pose 15/15 FE joints FK-verified). Zero sign transforms applied.
Zero SEMANTICS: both sides place zero at the extended, fingers-together hand; DB9's documented anchor is numerically attained (0.854 deg mean |angle|).
Angle convention: both are joint rotation magnitudes about fixed joint-specific axes, not derived interior angles (PIP round-trip 0.5-0.9 deg).
Range/wrapping: neither side wraps (criterion H PASS x16).
DB9 physical identity of all 8 channels: 77/77 stable, 0 of 8 KEEP channels changed.

DB9-internal anchor behaviour: for the six finger channels a positive change from the extended anchor to the flexed anchor (+31.72 to +123.79 deg, DIMENSION_CONFIDENCE_CLASSIFICATION.json); for the two thumb channels (MCP1, IP1) no extended->flexed anchor CHANGE is recorded in the artifacts (null), so their directional evidence rests on the A_FIST anchor at 77 participants (agreement 0.9221 and 1.0000 respectively).
The 8 DOFs are disjoint from every DOF the coordinate audit found directionally defective (middle/ring/pinky DIP and middle PIP).

DB9 WITHIN-SOURCE calibration provenance: the released angle of every one of the 8 channels is an exact affine map of a single raw glove column (FORENSIC_CORE.json .A_transform_forms, max residual 3.8e-12 to 1.6e-11 deg), and the recovered slope reproduces the published calibration gain to within 0.61% on every channel. The DB9 ruler is therefore fully known and auditable.
partially_closed: Sign compatibility of MCP1: 77-participant agreement 0.9221 (opposed 0.0779) rather than 1.0000. DB1 1.000, DB2 0.925, DB5 0.700 - DB5 alone rates MCP1 INCONCLUSIVE. The frozen rule pools all 77, so the KEEP is correct under the frozen rule; the per-source detail is a limitation, not a contradiction.

Numerical interchangeability: 4 of 8 are INTERCHANGEABLE_WITH_KNOWN_CONVENTION (IP1, PIP2, MCP4_f, PIP5), 4 of 8 are SEMANTICALLY_MATCHED_BUT_CALIBRATION_UNCERTAIN (MCP1, MCP2_f, MCP3_f, MCP5_f). None is DIRECTLY_INTERCHANGEABLE.
Source-database independence: 5 of 8 show a DB2-DB1 subject-level CI excluding zero (MCP2_f, PIP2, MCP3_f, MCP4_f, MCP5_f).
Numerical zero interchangeability: NOT_ESTABLISHED for all 8 (the emg2pose side is 0 by construction, not a measurement).
Handedness: criterion I UNCERTAIN x16; contained, not closed.
emg2pose official-limit adherence: 0.05%-20.97% of mini-corpus samples lie outside the official UmeTrack limits per DOF, and the frozen contract forbids clamping.

true_remaining_blockers.blocker: No CROSS-SOURCE calibration record exists, so 'same physical variable' does not yet imply 'same physical scale'. The DB9 ruler is fully known (recovered from the bytes) but emg2pose's is not, and the frozen head's decision boundaries were learned on DB9 scales.
true_remaining_blockers.severity: NON-TASK-DERIVED CALIBRATION / ZERO QUESTION - needs one minimal pre-declared check, not a redesign

true_remaining_blockers.blocker: Numerical zero interchangeability is NOT_ESTABLISHED: the emg2pose zero is a model-construction fact, not a measurement, and no cross-source zero comparison exists for any of the 8.

Source-database level shifts inside DB9 (5 of 8 DOFs) mean 'DB9' is not one calibration. A substitution result therefore cannot be attributed to upstream substitution alone unless source-database identity is carried as metadata.
true_remaining_blockers.severity: METADATA REQUIREMENT - no new measurement needed

not_a_blocker: The coordinate audit's classification of four dimensions as 'already trustworthy' is internally consistent with, and not contradicted by, the DROP of PIP3 as DB9's own middle-PIP channel. They measure different things: PIP3 (middle finger) is DROP; middle_pip_flexion is therefore ABSENT from the trusted-8, while ring_pip_flexion is INCONCLUSIVE and also absent. The trusted-8 contains exactly one PIP: PIP2 (index) and PIP5 (pinky).

next_minimal_check.question: On the local emg2pose mini corpus, at frames whose pose realises the DB9 documented reference posture (hand resting on the table, fingers closed together and extended), what is the per-DOF distribution of the 8 canonical16 values?
next_minimal_check.why_it_is_not_duplicating_previous_work: The audit verified the DB9 side of the anchor (0.854 deg mean |angle|) and asserted the emg2pose side is 0 by construction. It never MEASURED the emg2pose side at an equivalent physical posture. That is the single missing term in the zero claim.
next_minimal_check.why_it_is_not_outcome_driven: It uses only GT joint angles and the official hand model. No task head, no labels, no probabilities, no margins, no accuracy, and no fitted parameter enters the check. The pass/fail rule is declared in advance.
next_minimal_check.data_required: docs-adjacent local emg2pose mini corpus (data/official/emg2pose_dataset_mini/*.hdf5, 30 sessions) plus generic_hand_model.json (sha256 96649ddf7d036be3357dadd7c13db325a18638c6713583fbbbdd71446ce07564).
next_minimal_check.expected_scope: Single CPU pass over ~4.2M frames of already-local 20D joint angles. Select frames by proximity to the DB9 reference-posture prototype in canonical16 space; report per-DOF median and p05/p95. Minutes.
next_minimal_check.pass_criterion: For every one of the 8 DOFs, the emg2pose value at the reference-posture frames lies within +/- 2 deg of 0, i.e. consistent with the DB9 anchor's own per-joint residuals (range 0.00 to 1.94 deg in absolute value). This would establish numerical zero interchangeability.
next_minimal_check.fail_criterion: Any DOF whose reference-posture frames sit at a non-zero level that exceeds the DB9 anchor residual by more than the DB9 anchor's own movement-to-movement spread would establish a per-DOF zero offset, which would be a hard blocker for head substitution and would have to be reported as a negative result.
next_minimal_check.note: If the natural mini corpus does not contain the reference posture at all, the check is NOT_EVALUABLE LOCALLY and must be reported as such - it must not be rescued by synthesising the pose from the model, because that would assume the model's zero equals the physical zero.
